# Queue settings

<!-- Generated by app/dev/gen_settings_docs.py from the bot's variable definitions. Do not edit by hand. -->

Queue settings apply to a single queue. Change them in the web panel (select the queue in the
channel tree), with `/queue set <queue> <variable> <value>`, or all at once with
`!set_queue_cfg <queue> <json>`. Create a queue with **Create queue** in the web panel or
`/queue create_pickup <name> <size>`.

Durations are written like `1h 30m`, `45m` or `00:15:00`. Roles and channels are picked from a list in the web panel; in chat use a mention or the name.

## General

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Queue name | `name` | text | not set |  |
| Queue size | `size` | number | not set |  |
| is default | `is_default` | on / off | `on` | Set if users can add to this queue without specifying its name. |
| is ranked | `ranked` | on / off | `off` | Enable rating features on this queue. |
| Start when full | `autostart` | on / off | `on` |  |
| Require check-in | `check_in_timeout` | duration | `00:05:00` | Set the check-in stage duration. |
| Allow discard check-in | `check_in_discard` | on / off | `on` | Allow to discard participation during the check-in stage and abort the match if not everyone is ready in time. |
| Check-in discard immediately | `check_in_discard_immediately` | on / off | `on` | Revert check-in state immediately when someone discards check-in |
| Promotion role | `promotion_role` | role | not set | Set a role to highlight on !promote and !sub commands. |
| Blacklist role | `blacklist_role` | role | not set | Users with this role wont be able to add to this queue. |
| Whitelist role | `whitelist_role` | role | not set | Only users with this role will be able to add to this queue. |
| Match lifetime | `match_lifetime` | duration | not set | Set a custom match life time before it times out then ranked is enabled. Default: 3 hours. |
| Aliases | `aliases` | table | empty | Other names for this queue, you can also group queues by giving them a same alias. |

**Aliases** (`aliases`) is a table with the columns `alias`.
Other names for this queue, you can also group queues by giving them a same alias.

## Teams

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Force team size | `team_size` | number | not set | Force a maximum amount of players per team. |
| Pick teams | `pick_teams` | choice | `draft` | Set how teams should be picked:<br>draft - host a draft stage where captains will have to pick players<br>matchmaking - form teams automatically based on players ratings<br>random teams - form teams randomly<br>no teams - do not form teams, only print the players list |
| Pick captains | `pick_captains` | choice | `by role and rating` | Set how captains should be picked (for 'draft' or 'no teams' above):<br>by role and rating - sort by captain role and rating and pick the best<br>fair pairs - pick random pair of players with closest ratings to each other<br>random with role preference - pick captains randomly with preference of the captain role<br>random - pick captains randomly<br>no captains - do not pick captains automatically |
| Teams picking order | `pick_order` | text | `abababba` | a - 1st team picks, b - 2nd team picks, example: ababba |
| Team names | `team_names` | text | not set | Team names separated by space, example: Alpha Beta |
| Team emojis | `team_emojis` | text | not set | Team emojis separated by space. |
| Captains role | `captains_role` | role | not set | Users with this role may have preference in captains choosing process. |

## Appearance

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Description | `description` | multi-line text | not set | Set an answer on '!help queue' command. |
| Start message | `start_msg` | multi-line text | not set | Set additional information to be printed on a match start. |
| Start direct message | `start_direct_msg` | multi-line text | not set | Set the content of a direct message sent to players when the queue starts.<br>You can use this aliases in text: {queue}, {channel}, {server}.<br>If not set, default translated message is used. |
| Server | `server` | multi-line text | not set | Print this server on a match start. |
| Promotion message | `promotion_msg` | multi-line text | not set | Replace default promotion message. You can use {name}, {role} and {left} placeholders in the text. |
| Show streamers | `show_streamers` | on / off | `on` | Show streaming players on a match start. |

## Maps

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Map count | `map_count` | number | `1` | Number of maps to show on match start. |
| Map cooldown | `map_cooldown` | number | `1` | Prefer to not choose last played map(s) for the next specified matches amount.<br>This affects map voting pools as well. Set 0 to disable. |
| Vote poll map count | `vote_maps` | number | not set | Set to enable map voting, this requires check-in timeout to be set. |
| Maps | `maps` | table | empty | List of maps to choose from. |

**Maps** (`maps`) is a table with the columns `name`.
List of maps to choose from.
